avis.texte: I have liked Avene products as they are generally mindful of eliminating harsh or irritating ingredients, and had high hope for this moisturizer. I was surprised with the strong scent. I tried it a few days hoping it might not be irritating. While it provided moisture, it also unfortunately caused some white bumps which is a definite negative reaction. Disappointed that Avene would add these ingredients. Unless you have skin that can tolerate anything, I could not recommend this.
This has been the ONLY moisturizer I use for the past at least 5 years. Its very light, skin absorb it so quick. Not sticky. Not oily. It has a great texture. So light.

I tried the product by itself it was fine, but after i added other essence, it will flake when you rub your skin. Smell is strong so probably not good for sensitive skin. I have combination so it was fine for me. Not as hydrating in the winter. Would not purchase again.

i have oily skin and anytime i go to bed every moisturizer i have used has left me slick with oil the next morning and unfortunately this one was them as others. i used it in the morning too and it sat well under makeup but my face did get oily just as fast with other moisturizers.

After just one week of use, this product caused severe breakouts that took months to clear up. Unfortunately, I still have scars from the terrible acne it caused. Skin products are relative so, if you have sensitive skin, I would not recommend this product.
My mistake to miss that this is Not unscented. I like many of the Avene products but I really don't like scents in face lotions and cleansers. The lotion is very moisturizing but I won't repurchase.

I have combination/oily/sensitive/acne prone skin. I am very very easily irritated by just about everything in skincare and this didn't irritate my skin. I did find the fragrance a bit strong upon application, but it faded pretty quickly to me. the packaging is a lot smaller than I expected for the price, but I didn't need a huge amount of product to get the job done. this moisturizer is moisturizing and helped my dehydrated skin. if your skin leans more dry or needs a heavy moisturizer then this IS NOT for you. this is very light weight which I can appreciate cause I hate the feeling of anything on my face. I don't wear make up so I can speak for how it wear under it. I will repurchase just because this is a really nice light weight product and hasn't caused my skin any acne, irritation, or sensitivity. usually I would use Peter Thomas Roth water drench cloud cream but I found it wasn't hydrating enough with my salicylic acid acne treatment.

THE BEST moisturizer ever! The feel, texture, and smell are so luxurious. I splurged and bought myself a few items for Christmas. It does not bother my Eczema-prone skin at all. I feel like I'm in a high dollar hotel when I apply it to my skin. It's just wonderful stuff!
